summary: Iteration 6 validates 2 new features: (A) payment_method (card|gcash|maya) on /api/payments/checkout-session, and (B) EN/TL i18n toggle. BACKEND: created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_6_payments.py -> 26/26 PASS with the full regression suite (backend_test.py + iteration_6). Verifies mock path returns {mock:true, payment_method, checkout_url containing method=..., session_id starting mock_} and persists payment_method + checkout_session_id on the booking for each of card/gcash/maya; unknown method 'paypal' -> 400; mock-confirm on gcash and maya sessions marks booking payment_status=paid and preserves payment_method; PHP rates regression (all 6 artists rate_per_hour >= 10000). Also updated backend_test.py stale deposit==50 assertion to deposit==2900. FRONTEND (mobile 390x844, demo@inked.dev): Profile screen — lang-en / lang-tl testIDs work; tapping TAGALOG re-labels ALL Profile menu items to Tagalog (AKING WISHLIST, MGA BOOKING, MENSAHE, TUKLASIN ANG ARTIST, WIKA, TULONG, PRIVACY AT TERMS, MAG-SIGN OUT) and bottom tab titles (TUKLASIN, BOOKINGS, MENSAHE, PROFILE) with the active TAGALOG chip highlighted red + check mark. Discover in TL: greeting 'KUMUSTA, DEMO', title 'TUKLASIN', featured badge 'ARTIST NG LINGGO', CTA 'MAG-BOOK NA' all present in DOM. Artist detail shows PHP rate ₱12500/HR. Booking Step 1 renders correct DATE/TIME/HOURS section headers with date-YYYY-MM-DD and time-HH:MM testIDs; BOOKED slots correctly disabled with strike-through (regression preserved). Full happy-path click-through to Step 3 payment pills could not be completed in the UI because prior pytest test data has consumed most 14:00 slots on the nearest date range (each test creates real bookings), but backend fully proves the payment_method persistence and mock-confirm flow, and the payment-method-* testIDs / labels are wired per the source code spec. Regression: favorites toggle, artist heart/share, portfolio, cancellation-policy link, availability BOOKED chips — all still render with expected testIDs.
action_items: Consider adding a `POST /api/test/reset` (dev-only) or timestamped-slot cleanup so end-to-end UI happy-path tests do not exhaust available time slots after repeated pytest runs (the demo user already had 14:00 booked on Sept 8, 2026).

Optional: expose the mock-confirm path via a query-param on the booking-confirm page instead of window.alert() so headless Playwright can complete the happy path without a native dialog handler (dialogs did fire but web-preview alert timing is race-prone).
Optional accessibility: payment-method pills should include accessibilityLabel (e.g. 'Pay with GCash') for screen readers; testIDs are already good.

Stripe key still 'sk_test_emergent' — mock path remains active until real key is provisioned. Once swapped, verify 'gcash' actually creates a real Stripe session with payment_method_types=['gcash'] (Stripe supports gcash in PH), and note that 'maya' falls back to ['card'] because Stripe does not natively support Maya.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L582-587: STRIPE_METHOD_MAP maps maya -> ['card'] silently. Good for MVP but the response returns payment_method='maya' which is a small user-facing lie — consider adding {fallback_to:'card'} in the response so the client can show a hint 'Maya via card rails'.

server.py L607-610: mock path stores payment_method via $set inside an update guarded by payment_status != 'paid' — correct. However, if the same booking is re-initiated with a different method before payment, the old method is overwritten (expected). No issue.
server.py L601: `body.payment_method.lower()` — safe, but if body.payment_method is None (Pydantic default 'card') this still works. Good.

book/[artistId].tsx step 3: payment-method-{card|gcash|maya} testIDs are per spec. Ensure the confirm button label uses the localized 'PAY ₱2,900 DEPOSIT' / 'BAYARAN ₱2,900 DOWNPAYMENT' string — task spec confirms this is wired via useI18n.
i18n.tsx: locale persisted via storage util — fresh incognito sessions restart at EN; expected behavior.

Tab _layout must re-mount when locale changes; the app tree already re-renders because useI18n subscribes to context. Verified visually via screenshots (TUKLASIN / MENSAHE labels update in the bottom bar).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for i18n (Profile + Discover + Tabs); 90% for Booking Step 3 (testIDs verified in code + labels, UI happy-path click-through blocked by test-data slot exhaustion, not a bug)

seed_data_creation: Test suite creates ~6 far-future bookings on artist[0] for various time slots (08:00, 08:30, 09:30, 10:15, 11:15, 12:15). Consider periodic cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New payload field: POST /api/payments/checkout-session accepts {booking_id, platform, payment_method: 'card'|'gcash'|'maya'}. Mock path (Stripe placeholder 'sk_test_emergent') returns {checkout_url, session_id (mock_...), mock:true, payment_method} and $set's payment_method on the booking. Unknown method -> 400. POST /api/payments/mock-confirm marks booking paid (payment_status='paid', payment_intent_id='pi_mock_...'). Frontend: useI18n() context with EN + TL locales, storage-backed. Profile screen has lang-en and lang-tl testIDs. Booking step 3 has payment-method-card/-gcash/-maya testIDs. Demo user (demo@inked.dev / testpass123) still valid. Backend regression tests all pass (26). Available time slots for demo user on Sept 8 2026 shrink after each pytest run — restart tests on a further date or clean up TEST_ bookings periodically.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All new features working; UI happy-path partially blocked by cumulative test-booking slot consumption (test data hygiene, not a product bug).
